english_classification.chapter_title: The Explanation of the Peace, what it is; the Right Hand; the Kiss; the Salutation.
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter presents the five ritual signs (peace, right hand, kiss, salutation, laying on of hands) as cosmic archetypes established by the First Man's descent to battle and ascent from victory. The oldest teaching layer is a two-series cosmological narrative: Series 1 (descent, ¶3–9) is nearly pure substrate; Series 2 (ascent, ¶10–14) preserves substrate cosmic narrative overlaid with editorial bridge formulas ('appropriate to the mystery of X, this Y has come about among mankind'). Significant editorial fatigue confirmed: substrate drops from 6.68→2.02 while institutional rises 2.18→9.16 in the second half. The chapter transitions from pure cosmic teaching through mixed cosmic+bridge to fully institutional application (¶16–19) and exhortation (¶21–24). A Light Form/Daēnā passage (¶20) preserves genuinely ancient Persian imagery of the soul's cosmic encounter. The Psalm 110:1 citation in ¶14 is a clear editorial insertion within cosmic narrative. The five-fold enumeration structure (peace, right hand, kiss, salutation, laying on of hands) is the substrate's organizational spine.
